title: Merge the shape and execution gates into one approval, preserving both preconditions
action: Per D2, add a merged approval path so one call flips approved_gates.shape and approved_gates.execution together. bee state gate takes a single --name today (lib/command-registry.mjs:724-725), so this is a new code path, not a config change; both fields stay in .bee/state.json. Per D14, the merged approval INHERITS the high-risk advisor-consult refusal that bee.mjs:3292-3301 currently applies to the execution gate alone -- a naive merge would silently drop it for every high-risk feature. Per D15, extend the approved_for_plan_rev stamp (bee.mjs:3310-3330, lib/state-projection.mjs:132-140) to cover BOTH fields, so a state plan-rev bump revokes both and re-approval re-asks the one merged question, instead of leaving the gate half-revoked with execution false and shape true. Twins move in the same commit.

truths: One merged approval call sets both shape and execution true
The merged approval refuses for mode high-risk when advisor_ref is missing or stale
state plan-rev bump revokes both shape and execution
Approving the two gates separately still works
node packages/bee/tests/test_state_projection.mjs exits 0 with no hand-written 'validating' phase left in it

artifacts.substantive: merged approval handler carrying the advisor precondition
plan-rev stamp covering both gate fields

key_links: the merged path reuses the existing advisor-staleness check, never a copy of it
prohibitions: No removal of the standalone gate verb
No dropping the high-risk advisor precondition
No change to the context or review gates

trace.outcome: Added a --merge flag to bee state gate (D2): one call flips approved_gates.shape and approved_gates.execution together, additive alongside the unchanged standalone --name verb. It inherits the high-risk advisor-consult precondition via a shared requireFreshAdvisorForHighRisk helper extracted from the existing execution-gate check (D14), and stamps approved_for_plan_rev on BOTH gates so a plan-rev bump revokes both instead of half-revoking the merged gate (D15). Migrated 3 hand-written phase:'validating' fixtures in test_state_projection.mjs to 'planning' (vd-1 already retired the phase) and added 6 new CLI-level tests proving D2/D14/D15 and the standalone-still-works truth through the real bee.mjs dispatcher. Twins vendored byte-identical. Full verify green: 120+32+391 passed, 0 failed.
